Pricing questions

Which plan should I choose?

We suggest Pairs for two loved ones (like parents): one bill, and each person gets their own drills, coaching, and report. Choose Individual for one person, or Family if you're protecting up to four people, like both parents plus an aunt or in-law. You can change plans anytime.

Why does this cost more than a call blocker?

A blocker filters some scams. ScamPrep changes what happens when one gets through… and one always gets through. You’re paying for a skill, not just a service, plus quarterly proof it's growing.

When can we start?

Plans open this fall, in small onboarding cohorts. Join the early-access list and you're at the front. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and carries a 60-day money-back guarantee.

What if my loved one doesn't want it?

Then we don't enroll them, and you get a refund. Nobody gets drilled without their own yes. If they're unsure, ask us for a sample drill to show them first: hello@getscamprep.com

Is there a contract?

None. Monthly plans cancel anytime. Annual plans extend access through the end of your billing period.

A pamphlet won't help spot the next scam. Practice will.
